ruling_text:
Combs v. Insomnia Cookies, LLC et al.

Accordingly, the motion for approval of PAGA settlement is GRANTED. The Case Management Conference set for 2:30 p.m. on March 18, 2026 is VACATED, and the Court sets a compliance hearing for December 2, 2026 at 2:30 p.m. in Department 19. Plaintiff shall prepare the order.
